verdict.rationale: Postman offers CLI-driven collection runs, CI/CD integration, and webhooks (postman-docs-1,6,19,24) that can be scheduled to run automatically, and it has an 'Agent Mode' for natural-language actions (postman-docs-8,29), but there is no evidence of a persistent, AI-triggered background automation or monitor system that runs autonomously without a pipeline/human trigger. missing for 10: dedicated autonomous/AI-scheduled monitor documentation, evidence of unattended agentic execution loops, independent confirmation of such automations working in practice.
